Hi Sarah — thanks for sending these over. I reviewed the packet and a couple of fields are missing or need clarification before we can request a provisional PO in ProcureFlow: 

1) Procurement intake: we need the internal budget code (GL/Budget) that the invoices should be routed to. Please provide the 6-digit budget code.
2) Spend cap guidance: do you want an annual cap or an initial pilot cap? Our default for new vendors is a provisional spend lock while we complete tax & compliance checks.
3) Line-item granularity: the onboarding form lists two aggregated line items (Platform Services + Transaction Fees). For bookkeeping we prefer separate SKU lines for platform-monthly and transaction-volume so we can map to separate cost centers. Can you supply a CSV with SKU IDs and unit pricing?

I attached the ProcureFlow onboarding checklist that shows fields required to auto-issue a provisional PO token. If you prefer we can issue a provisional PO with a temporary token while you submit the SKU CSV, but accounting will require a follow-up change order to split the lines.

Attachments: procureflow_onboard_checklist.xlsx

Next steps / ask:
- Sarah: send budget code + confirm spend cap preference + attach SKU CSV
- Rafael / Ben: will review and request provisional PO token once intake fields are present

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Subject: Action: provisional PO issuance and line-item split for FluxPay (FP-2026-0487)

Team — looping accounting and sales to finalize. This thread summarizes decisions and the request to ProcureFlow: 

Summary:
- Vendor: FluxPay (vendor ID FXP-90021)
- Pilot spend cap: issue provisional PO with a temporary token for $30,000 (pilot). Pending successful compliance/Tax check, we will increase to annual cap $120,000 via a change order.
- Budget code: 84-2110 (provided by vendor)
- SKU split required: separate lines for PLATFORM_MONTHLY (SKU FXP-PLAT-M) and TRANSACTION_FEES (SKU FXP-TXN-F). FluxPay provided CSV; however the CSV uses aggregated fields for expected monthly volume which must be converted into unit price x estimated quantity per month in ProcureFlow.

Request to Procurement/Accounting (Monica / Marissa):
1) Create provisional PO in ProcureFlow using temporary PO token: P-2026-06-27142 and lock spend to $30,000.
2) Configure two line items:
   - Line 1: PLATFORM_MONTHLY | SKU FXP-PLAT-M | unit price $1,200 | qty 1 | account 84-2110
   - Line 2: TRANSACTION_FEES | SKU FXP-TXN-F | unit price $0.005 per txn | estimated qty 1,000,000 | account 84-2110 (record estimated qty as notional for forecasting)
3) Attach vendor W-9 and onboarding form to PO record and flag for compliance review.
4) After compliance completes, issue change order to bump spend cap to $120,000 and update final quantities.

Attachments: provisional_po_stub_P-2026-06-27142.pdf
Related ticket: https://procureflow.redwood.internal/tickets/PR-7623
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/record/ABC123-fluxpay-provisional-po

Sarah — we will issue P-2026-06-27142 as the provisional PO. Expect the stub and DocuSign request in your inbox later today for signature. Accounting: please confirm when the provisional PO token is created and when the lines are posted so I can close the onboarding loop with the customer.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
